summary.text: Mike Volz represents the 6th Legislative District, which includes part of Spokane County, Airway Heights, Medical Lake and Cheney, in the Washington House of Representatives. His official page describes him as serving his fifth term and as Treasurer for Spokane County.

paragraphs.text: Volz graduated from Eastern Washington University with a degree in business finance and accounting and holds an MBA from Gonzaga University, according to his official page.
It says he is a licensed CPA and an Army veteran who served as a military policeman in West Germany and at Fort Bragg, North Carolina.
The page says his work history includes small businesses, Spokane Transit, the health care industry and the transportation industry.
He serves on the Consumer Protection & Business, Technology, Economic Development, & Veterans, and Transportation committees, and lives in North Spokane with his wife, Diane.
